said: You are asked to report to the combined campus no later than Monday next, where you will be issued instructions, quartered, and enrolled.
title: Report for enrolment
brief: The Directorate wants this year's intake at the Candidate Gate by Monday: examined, instructed, kitted and enrolled.

want.stated: A new intake, enrolled and ready.
want.gm: The intake was brought forward two weeks because Nozomi refused the draft. The letter's BROUGHT FORWARD stamp is the only sign of it.

parts.text: Report to the Candidate Gate and show this letter
parts.detail: Hand in the return slip, completed in block capitals.
"A medical examination forms part of enrolment."
The letter says they are given on arrival.

parts.text: Draw uniform, bedding and personal equipment
parts.detail: "Uniform, bedding and personal equipment are issued on enrolment."

closes: At Kit Issue, when Nobu issues the uniforms. The same scene gives Vetch's docket.
suggestedRecord: Day 1, morning. Section Nine reported at the Candidate Gate with their letters, queued for Form 12-B, and saw the doctor called Mordant one at a time. In the Drill Hall the Deputy Director gave the intake two rules: curfew is a small thing, and a refused order is not. By the afternoon they had uniforms and a hundred and fifty credits of kit each from the quartermaster.
notes: Given as each player's own letter is shown in The Road In; it is one objective for the section, so pressing Give again changes nothing. The Hero Point for whoever first works out that all six were flagged must never become an objective: it is for working it out.
